extension.description: Flat branches in Source Control and a Git history panel with commit graphs and diffs.

action.checkoutRemoteNew: Remote source: {name} (create a local tracking branch)
action.deleteMergedOnly: Git only deletes a branch fully merged into its upstream, or into HEAD if no upstream is configured. The remote branch is not deleted.
action.deleteRemoteConfirm: Delete this branch from the server?
action.deleteRemotePolicy: This deletes the actual server branch, even if it has not been merged, when server rules allow it. Local branches are not deleted.
action.pullPolicy: Git Branch will save the tracked edits in a named Stash, then try to restore the edits and their staged state. The recovery copy will be kept in Git Stashes.
action.updateStashBranch: Updating {name} requires temporarily stashing tracked changes.
action.updateCurrentPolicy: The extension will ask again if local edits need to be stashed.
action.updateInactivePolicy: This updates the branch without switching branches or changing working tree files.
action.checkoutUpdateConfirm: Checkout and update the selected branch?
action.checkoutUpdatePolicy: Checkout first, then fast-forward from the branch’s upstream. If the update stops, stay on the checked-out branch.
action.rebaseRewrite: Rebasing can rewrite commits on the current branch. Nothing will be pushed automatically.
action.worktreeBranch: New Local Branch for the Worktree · from {source}
action.worktreeConfirm: Create a worktree in a separate folder?
action.pushPick: Select the Local Branch to Push
action.pushAndTrack: Set Upstream After a Successful Push
action.pushCommittedOnly: Only committed changes will be pushed.
action.pushWillTrack: Set the upstream after a successful push.
action.compareSameBranch: Choose a different branch to compare.
action.compareDetached: HEAD is detached. Use Compare with… or Compare Branches to choose the base branch.
git.changedWork: HEAD or the working tree state
git.remoteMissing: The selected remote no longer exists.
git.remoteUrlMissing: This remote has no URL configured.
git.pushMultipleUrls: Pushing to a mirror remote or a remote with multiple push URLs is not supported.
git.missingBranchCommit: The branch is gone or its commit object is missing. Refresh and try again.
git.validBranchName: Enter a valid Git branch name.
git.invalidBranchName: This name does not follow Git branch naming rules.
git.branchConflict: This name has a ref path conflict with local branch {name}.
git.operationInProgress: Resolve the ongoing Git operation or unresolved conflicts before continuing.
git.branchInAnotherWorktree: {name} is in use by another worktree. Switch branches there first.
git.cannotDeleteCurrent: You cannot delete the current branch. Switch to a different branch first.
git.renameUnconfirmed: Could not verify the renamed branch {name}. Refresh and check the current state.
git.noTrackingRef: The upstream has no dedicated remote-tracking ref.
git.ambiguousRemoteBranch: Could not find a unique remote branch for {name}. Check the fetch refspecs.
git.remoteCheckoutPartial: Created {name}, but could not complete the operation: {detail}
git.remoteCheckoutTrackedPartial: Created {name} and set its upstream, but could not complete the operation: {detail}
git.pullNeedsLocalHead: Updating requires a current local branch with at least one commit.
git.pullCurrentOnly: You can only update the current branch. Switch to the target branch first.
git.pullNeedsUpstream: Configure a valid remote upstream for the selected branch before updating.
git.checkoutUpdateNeedsOther: Select another local branch to checkout and update.
git.checkoutUpdatePartial: Checked out {name}, but could not finish updating: {detail}
git.branchCheckedOutAt: {name} is checked out at {path}. Update it in that worktree or switch branches there first.
git.updateStashCancelled: Skipped the fast-forward because saving local changes was not approved. Local edits were not changed.
git.integrationLocalHead: Checkout a local branch with at least one commit before merging or rebasing.
git.integrationSameBranch: Select a branch other than the current branch as the source.
git.integrationCleanWork: Commit or stash staged and unstaged changes before merging or rebasing.
git.integrationUnrelated: No common ancestor is available locally. The branch was not changed.
git.rebaseUnsafePaths: The rebase may overwrite an untracked or ignored file. Move it to a safe location before retrying.
git.integrationFetchUnconfirmed: Fetched the server branch, but could not confirm integration into the current branch: {detail}
git.mergePaused: Merge stopped. Resolve conflicts in Source Control, then continue with git merge --continue or abort with git merge --abort. {detail}
git.rebasePaused: Rebase stopped. Resolve conflicts in Source Control, then continue with git rebase --continue or abort with git rebase --abort. {detail}
git.worktreeAbsolutePath: Enter an absolute folder path for the new worktree.
git.worktreeEmptyPath: Choose a new or empty folder outside Git’s metadata directories.
git.worktreeUnconfirmed: Could not confirm worktree creation at {path}. Check whether the folder or branch was created: {detail}
git.remoteDeleteDifferentUrl: The fetch and push URLs differ. Git Branch will not delete a branch from a potentially different server repository.
git.remoteDeleteSameRepository: This remote points to the current repository or a linked worktree. Use the local branch menu instead.
git.remoteDeleteUnverifiedLocal: Could not verify the repository at the local remote path. Deletion was not attempted.
git.remoteDeleteRejected: The server branch was not deleted. If the remote tip changed, fetch and review it before retrying: {detail}
git.remoteDeleteUnconfirmed: The server deletion could not be confirmed. Check the actual remote branch before retrying: {detail}
git.remoteDeleted: Deleted server branch {remote}/{name}. No local branch was deleted.
git.worktreeNotRegular: Only regular files are opened from the working tree. This entry is shown as change metadata only.
git.worktreePathUnavailable: The working tree path is no longer available or cannot be read safely. Refresh the comparison.
git.upstreamFetchMismatch: The upstream does not match the remote’s fetch mapping.
git.receiptCleanupFailed: Could not remove the temporary fetch ref.
git.fetchUnconfirmed: Could not confirm the upstream fetch. The local branch was not integrated: {detail}
git.fetchCommitUnconfirmed: Could not confirm which commit was fetched.
git.pullUpToDate: Fetched the upstream. The local branch is already up to date.
git.pullDiverged: Fetched the upstream, but cannot fast-forward. The local branch was not updated. Compare the branches to see the differences.
git.fastForwardStateUnexpected: The fast-forward command ran, but the checkout state is unexpected. Check the repository state.
git.fastForwardUnconfirmed: Fetched the upstream. The remote-tracking ref may have updated, but the local fast-forward was not confirmed: {detail}
git.updateSubmoduleChanged: Handle local submodule changes before updating. The extension cannot stash them safely.
git.updateIntentToAdd: A file is marked with intent to add. Stage it fully or unstage it before updating.
git.updateSaveBlocked: An untracked or ignored file occupies a path needed to save local changes. Move it to a safe location before retrying.
git.updateStashBaseChanged: HEAD no longer matches the saved changes.
git.updateStashMissing: Could not identify the new stash.
git.updateStashFailed: Could not safely save local changes: {detail}. Check Source Control and Git Stashes for {label} before retrying.
git.updateStashKept: Recovery copy kept in Git Stashes: {label} ({oid}).
git.updateRestored: Restored local edits and their staged state.
git.updateRestoreBlocked: Restoring may overwrite an untracked or ignored file.
git.updateRestoreFailed: Could not fully restore local changes: {detail}. Check Source Control before reapplying the recovery copy.
git.pushLocalOnly: Select a local branch to push. Detached HEAD cannot be pushed here.
git.pushTrackingAmbiguous: This target does not map to a unique remote-tracking ref. Push without setting an upstream.
git.pushUnconfirmed: Could not confirm the push. Check the remote before retrying: {detail}
git.invalidCommitId: Git returned an invalid commit ID.
git.invalidParentId: The commit contains an invalid parent ID.
git.invalidLog: Could not parse the Git history.
git.invalidCommitDetails: Could not read the Git commit details.
git.incompleteFileChange: The Git file change record is incomplete.
git.invalidFileChange: Could not parse the Git file change.
git.multipleTrackingMappings: Remote-tracking ref {ref} has multiple mappings. The operation cannot continue safely.
git.invalidCommitCounts: Could not read commit counts for both sides.
git.missingParent: Cannot compute changes: parent commit {oid} is missing. No history objects were fetched.
git.blobTooLarge: The historical file exceeds 1 MiB. Only change metadata is shown.
git.blobNotText: This file is binary or not UTF-8. Only change metadata is shown.
history.allBranchesDescription: Local branches, remote-tracking branches, and HEAD
history.selectionHint: Ctrl/Cmd-click to add or remove a commit. Shift-click to select a range.
history.selectionLimit: You can select up to {count} commits at once.
history.expiredSnapshot: This historical snapshot is closed. Reopen it from Git History.
history.laneOverflow: This commit’s lane is outside the visible range.
history.shallow: Shallow clone: only locally available history is shown.
history.stale: A ref moved or was removed. This comparison still shows the pinned snapshots.
history.noLocalAncestor: No common ancestor is visible in local history.
history.noAncestor: The branches have no common ancestor.
history.sameTip: Both sides point to the same commit.
history.noUniqueCommits: There are no unique commits on either side.
history.noCommitsInRange: There are no commits in this range.
history.sharedExcluded: Shared history is not shown in this list.
history.noSnapshotChanges: The snapshots contain no file differences.
history.noWorktreeChanges: The working tree has no tracked file differences from this branch.
history.noSelectedChanges: The selected commits contain no file changes.
history.noCommitChanges: This commit contains no file changes.
history.snapshotNote: Comparing two pinned commit snapshots. Working tree changes are not included.
history.worktreeNote: Compares the selected branch with saved working tree files. Untracked files are excluded. Refresh after editing.
history.author: Author
history.mergeDiffNote: Only files that differ from every parent are listed. Open a file to compare the first parent with the merge result.
action.pushTargetFrom: Push {source} to {remote}: enter the target branch
action.historyResetChoose: Choose a reset mode. Accepting a mode resets the current branch.
action.historyResetSoftDetail: Move the branch without changing the index or working tree.
action.historyResetMixedDetail: Move the branch and replace the index. Do not rewrite working tree files.
action.historyResetKeepDetail: Update affected files and stop if Git would overwrite conflicting edits.
action.historyResetHardDetail: Replace the index and affected working tree files. Staged and unstaged tracked edits can be lost.
action.historyUndoPolicy: Move the branch to the parent. The undone changes remain staged; working tree files are not changed.
action.historySquashPolicy: Fold the currently staged changes into this commit and replay any later commits. This rewrites local history.
action.historyDropPolicy: Remove this commit from the current branch and replay any later commits. This can remove changes from the working tree.
git.rebaseCancelled: Rebase cancelled. The current branch was not changed.
git.rebaseFetchedCancelled: Fetch completed. Rebase cancelled; the current branch was not changed.
git.historyCommitUnavailable: The selected commit is no longer available.
git.historyTagConflict: The name conflicts with the ref path for tag {name}.
git.historyUndoHead: Only the current branch's HEAD commit can be undone.
git.historyNeedsParent: This operation requires a parent commit.
git.historyLinearOnly: Only commits in a linear range of the current branch can be rewritten. The selected commit and the replay range cannot contain a merge.
git.historyPublished: A local remote-tracking ref contains this commit. The extension will not rewrite it.
git.historyUnsafePaths: This operation could overwrite an untracked or ignored path. Move or keep the local file elsewhere first.
git.historyLocalRequired: Checkout a local branch before running this operation.
git.historyResetCurrent: The current branch already points to the selected commit.
git.historyCleanRequired: Finish or save your staged and unstaged changes before running this history operation.
git.historyMergeUnsupported: Select non-merge commits. The extension does not guess which merge parent to use.
git.historyNotIncluded: Every selected commit must already belong to the current branch's history.
git.historyAlreadyIncluded: One or more selected commits already belong to the current branch's history.
git.historyStageRequired: Stage the changes to squash first. Submodule changes and intent-to-add entries are not supported.
git.historyStagedOnly: Squashing into an earlier commit requires staged changes with no unstaged tracked edits.
git.historyUnsafeIndex: Hard reset is blocked because the index has skip-worktree or assume-unchanged files, or a submodule has local changes.
git.historyCheckedOut: Checked out {oid} in detached HEAD state.
git.historyRevertPaused: Revert paused. Resolve in Source Control and run git revert --continue, or use --abort. {detail}
git.historyPickPaused: Cherry-pick paused. Resolve in Source Control and run git cherry-pick --continue, or use --abort. {detail}
git.historyUndone: Undid {oid}. Check the staged changes in Source Control.
git.historyMessageInvalid: Enter a nonempty commit message up to 128 KiB, without NUL characters.
git.historyMessageUnchanged: The commit message was not changed.
git.historySquashDoesNotApply: The staged patch cannot be applied to the selected commit. The index was not changed. {detail}
git.historyRewritePaused: History rewrite paused. Resolve in Source Control and run git rebase --continue, or use --abort. {detail}
git.historySquashUnconfirmed: Could not complete the rewrite. Inspect the current branch and recover the staged changes from the saved copy if needed. {detail}
git.historyPatchFileLimit: Select no more than {count} files per operation.
git.historyPatchUnsupported: These changes cannot be applied as a safe file patch. Choose complete changes between repository versions of regular files.
git.historyPatchPathsOverlap: The selected paths overlap or differ only in case. They cannot be applied in one safe batch.
git.historyPatchCheckFailed: The batch did not pass the patch check. No changes were applied. {detail}
git.historyPatchFailed: Git could not finish applying the patch. Check your working tree before retrying. {detail}
git.historyPatchApplied: Applied changes for {count} file(s) to the working tree without staging or committing.
history.staleAction: The selected commits, files, or checkout changed. Open the menu again and retry.
history.noRepositoryVersion: This change has no readable repository version.
history.filterText: Filter by message, author, or hash
history.filterTextHint: Filter commits by message, author name, or hash prefix.
history.filteredEmpty: No commits match the current filter.
history.editWarning: This rewrites local history. Staged changes will not be included.
